notes.title: Release Date for October 2025!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030639/7a81294f9855984d111be389c3de413262f349ae.png"]

We have decided to Launch in October! You can check out the new Demo late Aug. We've been hard at work with all new features and all new game modes that we know you'll love!! Check them out below!

Skirmish Mode

Conquest Mode

Survival Mode/Tower Defense



New Units such as 

Horses

Grenadiers

Transport Vehicles

Gun Cars

Bomber Planes

Air-balloons

Over 50 New Countryballs To Choose from

and more!



We also have new Gameplay features coming to you!

Re-worked Ideology System

Unit Upgrade System

Outfit your Units

New Skins for all Units for better customization



Story Mode has gone through a few re-works and updates with better gameplay mechanics, better graphics, more effects/explosions, and cutscenes!

Cutscenes

Graphics

Animations



We know we have been a little quiet about Countryball The Real time Strategy Game but we wanted to make sure we came back with great news. Please stay tuned!



Thanks for reading and if you haven't already, please consider adding Countryball The Real time Strategy Game to your Wishlist!! thank you! Have a blessed day!



-The Countryball Team!

notes.title: Countryball Strategy Game Demo Update 1
notes.notes:
Countryball Strategy Game Demo Update 1, Introduces a number of additional features and Bug fixes 

Demo- https://store.steampowered.com/app/2405310/Countryball_The_Real_Time_Strategy_Game/

-Added WASD for Camera Control
-Added Full screen and the option to toggle full screen in the Option menu
-Added the ability to cancel Units by (Right Clicking the next in Queue)
-Added the option to go to the (Main menu) from the mission screen
-Added Edge Scrolling (Mouse can now move the camera when at the edge of the screen)
-Added Repair Button next to the Demolish Button
-Added Melee Soldier Outfit
-Added Ranged Soldier Outfit
-Added Worker Outfit

-Fixed some issues that caused lag

-------------------------------

-Outfitter removed for reworking

Please Report all bugs on the discord!
https://discord.gg/3QgasjGPHM
